code='''def transform(grid):
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value != 0]
    top = min(r for r, c in cells)
    bottom = max(r for r, c in cells)
    left = min(c for r, c in cells)
    right = max(c for r, c in cells)
    height = (bottom - top + 1) // 2
    width = (right - left + 1) // 2
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]
'''
